instructions.objective:
Do these steps in order.
1. Click the main menu button (three lines, top left) so the menu opens.
2. Is this true right now: "the main menu is open and shows its items"? Store exactly yes or no as 'ready'.
3. Click once on an empty part of the canvas, near the bottom middle of the page, away from the menu and from any button. Then wait 2 seconds. Do not press Escape and do not click the menu button again.
4. Is this true right now: "the main menu is still open"? Store exactly yes or no as 'broken'. Store one short sentence describing what you see as 'seen'.
Both yes and no are fine answers. Report what is on the screen, then stop.
